output_text: P2P baby monitor web app using WebRTC (PeerJS) + Vite + TypeScript. Each station self-contained with `init*` returning `CleanupHandle` and MUST return `{ cleanup: () => void }` (proper teardown). Error handling: Use `querySelectorOrThrow()`—never silently fail on missing DOM. Never use `querySelector` without null check (use `querySelectorOrThrow`). URL state sync via URL params (`station`, `roomId`). Wake Lock: Always request on station init,
